scripts.assets: mkdir -p public/fonts public/vendor && cp node_modules/@fontsource/bricolage-grotesque/files/bricolage-grotesque-latin-600-normal.woff2 public/fonts/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource/bricolage-grotesque/files/bricolage-grotesque-latin-700-normal.woff2 public/fonts/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource/dm-sans/files/dm-sans-latin-400-normal.woff2 public/fonts/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource/dm-sans/files/dm-sans-latin-500-normal.woff2 public/fonts/ && cp node_modules/html5-qrcode/html5-qrcode.min.js public/vendor/
scripts.compile: python3 scripts/write_runtime_config.py && npm run bootstrap:elm && elm make src/Main.elm --output=public/app.js
scripts.build: npm run assets && python3 scripts/write_runtime_config.py && npm run bootstrap:elm && elm make src/Main.elm --optimize --output=public/app.js && python3 -m compileall server
scripts.dev: npm run assets && npm run compile && uvicorn server.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
